bar.page_text:
Lumen Ledger
How it works
Plans
Help
Know where your money goes

Lumen Ledger sorts every household bill into clear groups so you can see each month at a glance.

Start a free ledger
How it works

Add your bills once and the ledger sorts them for you every month, with a reminder before each one is due.

What it tracks
Rent and housing
Food and groceries
Travel and fuel
Power and water
Phone and internet
Gifts and treats

Households using the ledger paid 82% of their bills on time last month, and we hope you will too.

Fictional demo — no real accounts or payments.
